description: This file contains utility functions and classes for parsing and handling human-readable date and time expressions, including relative dates, date ranges, and special date calculations, used within the Apache Superset project.

classes.name: EvalText
classes.description: Represents a parsed text token, used to strip quotes from string literals.

classes.name: EvalDateTimeFunc
classes.description: Represents a parsed datetime function, evaluates to a datetime object.

classes.name: EvalDateAddFunc
classes.description: Represents a parsed date addition expression, evaluates to a datetime.

classes.name: EvalDateDiffFunc
classes.description: Represents a parsed date difference expression, evaluates to an integer.

classes.name: EvalDateTruncFunc
classes.description: Represents a parsed date truncation, evaluates to a datetime.

classes.name: EvalLastDayFunc
classes.description: Represents a parsed last day of period calculation, evaluates to a datetime.

classes.name: EvalHolidayFunc
classes.description: Represents a parsed holiday date, evaluates to a datetime.

classes.name: datetime_parser
classes.description: Cached function that returns a parser for date expressions.

classes.name: DateRangeMigration
classes.description: Contains regex patterns for migrating date range data from older formats.

methods.name: parse_human_datetime
methods.description: Converts a human-readable date string into a datetime object, raising errors if ambiguous or invalid.

methods.name: normalize_time_delta
methods.description: Converts a human-readable time delta string into a dictionary with a time unit and value.

methods.name: dttm_from_timetuple
methods.description: Converts a struct_time object to a datetime object.

methods.name: get_past_or_future
methods.description: Calculates a datetime in the past or future based on a human-readable string.

methods.name: parse_human_timedelta
methods.description: Returns a timedelta object from a human-readable string.

methods.name: parse_past_timedelta
methods.description: Calculates a timedelta representing a period in the past based on a string.

methods.name: get_relative_base
methods.description: Determines the base reference ('now' or 'today') for relative date calculations.

methods.name: handle_start_of
methods.description: Generates an expression for the start of a given time unit.

methods.name: handle_end_of
methods.description: Generates an expression for the end of a given time unit.

methods.name: handle_nth_of
methods.description: Handles 'first of' or similar expressions for specific date ranges.

methods.name: handle_modifier_and_unit
methods.description: Generates expressions based on modifiers like 'start of' or 'end of'.

methods.name: handle_scope_and_unit
methods.description: Generates expressions for relative scopes like 'last 2 weeks'.

methods.name: get_since_until
methods.description: Returns 'since' and 'until' datetime objects based on various string inputs and options.

methods.name: add_ago_to_since
methods.description: Adds 'ago' to a string if it indicates a past date, for backward compatibility.

methods.name: datetime_eval
methods.description: Evaluates a date expression string into a datetime object using the parser.
